notes: Setting: bedside nightstand at night, the phone's light on the wall flashing 8 times; the 8 MEGA badges are grouped by their real minutes (00:17 ×4, 00:18 ×4) with a generic gem icon (no official Mega symbol). The concept's bonus shiny list (shiny-dex-tentacool-krabby-kingler) was dropped: ASSETS.md gives it a different slug, so it is not confirmed to be the same customer and combining would need 'clientes diferentes'. It was replaced by the closing line 'Mega apareceu? O alarme toca.' The caption quote is shown only via its print crop, highlighted line by line, plus a 'Metal Stone / kkkkkk' stamp (verbatim words). Record-scratch = tape-stop + scratch SFX. Music: funk 130.
